title: Attention Is All You Need
summary: A transformer replaces recurrence with multi-head self attention for sequence transduction. Positional encodings retain token order while parallel computation supports translation.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
summary: Bidirectional transformer representations learn from masked language modeling and next sentence prediction. Fine tuning adapts a pretrained encoder to downstream language understanding.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
summary: A generator conditions on documents retrieved from an external corpus. Combining parametric model knowledge with nonparametric retrieval supports knowledge intensive question answering.

title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
summary: Dual encoders embed questions and passages into a shared vector space. Contrastive training and hard negative examples improve dense retrieval for open domain question answering.

title: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction over BERT
summary: Token level embeddings and a late interaction maximum similarity operator enable contextual passage ranking while document representations are precomputed.

title: BEIR: A Heterogeneous Benchmark for Zero-shot Evaluation of Information Retrieval Models
summary: A heterogeneous information retrieval benchmark evaluates generalization across domains and tasks. Sparse retrieval, dense retrieval and reranking are compared in zero shot settings.

title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
summary: Freezing pretrained weights and learning low rank update matrices reduces trainable parameters during adaptation of large language models.

title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
summary: Four bit quantization, low rank adapters and memory saving optimizations enable efficient fine tuning of large language models with reduced GPU memory.

title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
summary: An IO aware tiled attention algorithm reduces transfers between GPU memory and on chip storage. Exact attention computation uses less memory and improves throughput.

title: FlashAttention-2: Faster Attention with Better Parallelism and Work Partitioning
summary: Improved work partitioning and parallelism accelerate exact attention on GPUs while reducing non matrix multiplication operations.

title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
summary: A compact student learns soft probability targets from a larger teacher. Temperature scaled distributions transfer information beyond hard class labels.

title: DistilBERT, a distilled version of BERT: smaller, faster, cheaper and lighter
summary: Knowledge distillation compresses a pretrained language encoder using teacher predictions and representation alignment for efficient downstream inference.

title: SimCLR: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
summary: Contrastive learning pulls augmented views of the same image together and separates other images. Data augmentation and a projection head support self supervised representation learning.

title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
summary: Residual skip connections let deep convolutional networks learn corrections to input representations, improving optimization of image recognition networks.

title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
summary: An image is divided into patches and processed as a token sequence by a transformer. Large scale pretraining supports visual recognition.

title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
summary: A forward process adds noise to data and a learned reverse process removes it. Iterative denoising generates images from random noise.

title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
summary: Supervised instruction tuning and reinforcement learning from human feedback align language model outputs with human preferences.

title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
summary: Preference pairs directly optimize a language model through a classification style objective, avoiding a separately trained reward model and reinforcement learning loop.

title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Examples containing intermediate reasoning steps improve performance on arithmetic and symbolic tasks through chain of thought prompting.

title: Precise Zero-Shot Dense Retrieval without Relevance Labels
summary: Hypothetical document embeddings use a generated document to guide retrieval without labeled relevance pairs. The hypothetical text is encoded to search a document corpus.

title: Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks
summary: Siamese and triplet training produce sentence embeddings compared with cosine similarity for semantic search and sentence similarity.

title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
summary: A language model learns reflection tokens to decide when to retrieve evidence and critique generated text for relevance and support.
